categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in industrial computer products, including embedded single-board computers, industrial motherboards, embedded computers, vehicle-mounted computers, industrial LCD displays, rugged tablets, network security devices, AI edge computing platforms, IoT gateways, smart vending machines, smart street lighting solutions, and DMS design and manufacturing services. It also engages in medical computer design, manufacturing, and sales through subsidiaries. The business covers product design, manufacturing, logistics, and after-sales services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages embedded system design, AI edge computing, and industrial-grade hardware technologies. It employs SMT and plug-in soldering production lines, automated testing, and assembly lines. The products support multiple operating systems including Linux and Android, and incorporate advanced features such as fanless designs, ruggedized enclosures, and integration of AI accelerators like Nvidia and Intel modules. The company also emphasizes modular design and customization capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include system integrators, distributors, and end-users in vertical industries such as smart retail, smart manufacturing, smart transportation, network security, and AI edge computing. The company serves global markets with a focus on industrial automation, IoT applications, and medical computing. It actively develops large customers with annual purchases exceeding one million USD and supports small-volume or sample customers via e-commerce platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant sales in Taiwan, China, the United States, Europe, and Singapore. It has subsidiaries and branch offices in the US, Europe, Singapore, China, and Japan. Sales outside Taiwan account for over 90% of revenue, with Europe and the US showing strong growth. The company also maintains a presence in emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs, develops, and manufactures industrial computer hardware and systems, sourcing components such as semiconductors and PCBs from upstream suppliers. It sells finished products to system integrators and distributors who perform final system integration and sales to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening customized services, expanding AI edge computing platforms, continuous product and process innovation, and market expansion through joint ventures and acquisitions. R&D focuses on AI modules, edge computing devices, industrial innovation boards, IoT solutions for smart cities, and server platforms. The company collaborates with Intel and Nvidia to enhance AI capabilities and invests heavily in R&D, allocating over 7% of revenue to innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of industrial and embedded computing hardware, including customized ODM and DMS products. The company also earns income from extended warranty services and government subsidies. Sales are conducted via direct sales, distributors, and e-commerce platforms, with no significant reliance on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading industrial computer manufacturer with strong R&D and customization capabilities, differentiating through product quality, service, and integration with AI and IoT technologies. It competes with other industrial PC and embedded system providers, emphasizing vertical market specialization and strategic alliances, including its affiliation with the ASUS Group. Market share data is not publicly available, but the company is recognized for innovation and quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$8.35 billion in 2022, a 32% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to the parent company reaching NT$1.07 billion and EPS of NT$10.03. It has shown consistent growth in revenue, gross profit, and net income over recent years, achieving record-high financial performance in 2022. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets exceeding NT$11 billion and equity over NT$8.6 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior embedded design capabilities, continuous innovation, and high-quality manufacturing as core competitive advantages. It offers flexible, fast, and high-quality customized services tailored to vertical industry needs. Its product portfolio integrates advanced AI and edge computing technologies, ruggedized designs, and comprehensive after-sales support, positioning itself as a trusted technology service provider rather than just a hardware manufacturer.
